how: We read the website of every San Diego wedding photographer listed on Lazo (137 listings, 111 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: a Pacific Northwest photographer with a San Diego listing, a multi-city studio's local landing page, and event and portrait photographers whose sites are mostly headshots and families. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: How do you handle the flat midday light on the beach and the fog that can sit over the coast until early afternoon?
Can I see a full gallery from one wedding at a venue like mine, not just the highlights?
What is the delivery timeline, and is a second shooter included or an add-on?

picks.name: Ian Andrew Photography
picks.blurb: Ian Andrew Siso is a San Diego artist, sculptor and photographer, born on a military base in England and raised in Chula Vista, shooting weddings since 2009. Collections run 6, 8, 10 or 12 hours and include a minimum of six hours of wedding-day coverage.

picks.name: Harmony Haft Photography
picks.blurb: A full-time wedding and elopement photographer who started in 2013 and has shot over 500 weddings, plus artists like Snoop Dogg and events at the United Nations. Harmony Haft prints her pricing: six-hour and longer packages start at $4,500, with an average of $5,500.

picks.name: Astray Photography: San Diego wedding Photographer & San Diego engagement photographer
picks.blurb: Brittney and Andy are a North County husband-and-wife team with over a decade of experience and more than a thousand love stories documented in photo and video. Andy was senior staff photographer for concerts and sports at SDSU; Brittney studied visual communications at FIDM.

picks.name: Emry Photography
picks.blurb: Emily and Ryan Burhop have photographed San Diego weddings and engagements since 2012, more than ten years across Southern California and beyond. Emry Photography describes itself as storytellers first, aimed at free spirits and romantics at heart.

picks.name: Paul Douda Photography
picks.blurb: Paul Douda shot his first wedding on film in 2004 and has spent more than two decades photographing celebrations in San Diego and around the world. The site says its pricing is straightforward and transparent, laid out as collections.

picks.name: Fonyat Wedding Photographer
picks.blurb: Julio Fonyat photographs weddings and engagements in a natural, timeless style and says telling a couple's story starts with knowing the people. Based in Carlsbad, he has shot San Diego's venues from beaches to ballrooms and vineyards to fairways, with destination work too.

picks.name: MKL Images
picks.blurb: Mary runs MKL Images as photographer, editor, blogger and accountant, born in Carlsbad and living the coastal life ever since with her husband David and three boys. Packages deliver fully edited high-resolution files, with video, content creation, a photo booth and an album as add-ons.

picks.name: Madeline Barr Photography
picks.blurb: Maddie shoots film and digital for couples who want honest photographs without spending the whole day taking them. Raised in New England with a camera in hand since age seven, Madeline Barr is now based in San Diego.

picks.name: Vishaka Kavle Photography
picks.blurb: Vishaka Kavle blends a cinematic editorial style with documentary storytelling, capturing the day as it unfolds without scripting it. She works San Diego, Los Angeles and Palm Springs, plus destinations around the globe.

picks.name: Oakenheart Photography
picks.blurb: Oakenheart is a SoCal photo and video duo whose style is rooted in a love of the natural world, from adventure engagements to multi-day weddings. The collections page prints its numbers, including a $350 engagement session that is free with six or more hours of coverage.

picks.name: Carlsbad Photo
picks.blurb: A Carlsbad wedding photographer with over 10 years of experience, a hat collection of more than 20 and a start that came when her dad handed her a film camera and showed her the darkroom. Carlsbad Photo covers Carlsbad and San Diego weddings.

picks.name: Reimo Photography
picks.blurb: Hamid of Reimo Photography treats a wedding story as a piece of art, with an editorial, candid style and a calm approach meant to let you stay in the day. Based in Carmel Valley, near Del Mar and the Fairmont Grand Del Mar.
